query: select "meals"."id", "meals"."photo_id", "meals"."occurred_at", "meals"."manual_calories_kcal", "latest_estimate"."model", "latest_estimate"."analyzed_at", "latest_estimate"."input_hash", "latest_estimate"."calories_kcal", "latest_estimate"."protein_grams", "latest_estimate"."fat_grams", "latest_estimate"."carbohydrate_grams", "latest_estimate"."source_job_id", "latest_analysis_job"."id", "latest_analysis_job"."status", "latest_analysis_job"."summary" from "meals" left join "nutrition_estimates" "latest_estimate" on "latest_estimate"."id" = (select "id" from "nutrition_estimates" where "nutrition_estimates"."meal_id" = "meals"."id" order by "nutrition_estimates"."analyzed_at" desc, "nutrition_estimates".rowid desc limit ?) left join "jobs" "latest_analysis_job" on "latest_analysis_job"."id" = (select "id" from "jobs" where ("jobs"."kind" = ? and (json_extract("jobs"."payload_json", '$.mealId') = "meals"."id" or (json_extract("jobs"."payload_json", '$.mealId') is null and "meals"."photo_id" is not null and "jobs"."created_at" >= "meals"."recorded_at" and (("meals"."manual_calories_kcal" is null and "latest_estimate"."id" is null) or "latest_estimate"."source_job_id" = "jobs"."id")))) order by "jobs"."created_at" desc, "jobs".rowid desc limit ?) where "meals"."deleted_at" is null order by "meals"."occurred_at" desc

insert into "monitor_notifications" ("id", "incident_id", "endpoint", "kind", "slot", "body", "status", "attempts", "next_attempt_at", "lease_token", "lease_expires_at", "accepted_at", "created_at") select lower(hex(randomblob(16))) as "id", "monitor_incidents"."id", "push_subscriptions"."endpoint", ? as "kind", 0 as "slot", ? as "body", 'pending' as "status", 0 as "attempts", ? as "nextAttemptAt", null as "leaseToken", null as "leaseExpiresAt", null as "acceptedAt", ? as "createdAt" from "monitor_incidents" inner join "push_subscriptions" on 1 where ("monitor_incidents"."target_id" = ? and "monitor_incidents"."resolved_at" is not null and exists (select "id" from "monitor_notifications" "accepted_alert" where ("accepted_alert"."incident_id" = "monitor_incidents"."id" and "accepted_alert"."endpoint" = "push_subscriptions"."endpoint" and "accepted_alert"."accepted_at" is not null and "accepted_alert"."kind" = ?))) on conflict do nothing
